integrity: All 208 published facets are embedded in the verifier. Exact bit-vector chain reduction proves the H3 dimension, exhausts every five-vertex support, and checks the 91,91,91 class balance. Published topology and tightness are used for context, not as substitutes for the new class-level computation.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the labelled triangulation (S3 x S3)^a_13 and to mod-two middle homology. It does not determine the integral classes of the 273 embedded tetrahedral 3-spheres or compare the other known thirteen-vertex triangulations.
title: Perfectly balanced shortest \(H_3(\mathbf F_2)\)-carriers in a minimal thirteen-vertex \(S^3\times S^3\)
